# SOP-04 Validate (fixture)

### Step 1. Check page age

Compare the compile time of each index page with the staleness limit and list every project that is older.

### Step 2. Check contradictions

Read the pages of one project side by side and list every statement that disagrees with another page.

### Step 3. Report the findings

Print one line per project with the health token, the number of stale pages, and the next action.
